description: Anticipation-hold-push camera move toward a FX event. Classic film camera move for impact revelation and dramatic tension.

orchestration_stages.label: Camera Start Position
orchestration_stages.description: Place camera at starting position — back, elevated slightly, hero element in lower third.
orchestration_hints: Lens: 35–50mm for push-in feel. Avoid very wide.
Hero element in lower-center or lower-third of frame.
artistic_constraints: Start position must keep hero element readable.
Sky must be visible in upper portion of frame for backdrop.

orchestration_stages.label: Anticipation Hold
orchestration_stages.description: Camera holds still before event — builds tension.
orchestration_hints: Micro-jitter optional — subtle breathing motion 0.01–0.05m amplitude.
Camera focus on hero element pre-event.
artistic_constraints: MINIMUM 12 frames of hold — not less.
Slight depth-of-field focus on hero element.

orchestration_stages.label: Event Trigger Frame
orchestration_stages.description: Frame at which explosion/event begins. Camera hold ends here.
orchestration_hints: Keyframe at event frame. Push begins on this frame or 2 frames after.

orchestration_stages.label: Push In Move
orchestration_stages.description: Camera accelerates toward FX element after event trigger.
orchestration_hints: Ease-in from held position. Acceleration builds over 8–12 frames.
Path curves slightly — not dead-straight push.
artistic_constraints: Velocity must accelerate — not constant speed.
Slight rotation during push creates parallax depth.
Hero element must remain in frame throughout push.
Camera must not enter the FX bounding volume.

orchestration_stages.label: Slow Motion Reveal at End
orchestration_stages.description: Optional slow-motion reveal as camera reaches closest approach.
orchestration_hints: Frame range must be extended to match time scale.
Motion blur enabled — not frozen look.
artistic_constraints: Motion blur must be ON during slow-motion.
Frame range must account for time scale extension.

review_expectations.acceleration: Push velocity accelerates — not constant. Ease-in.
review_expectations.parallax: Slight rotation during push creates depth.
review_expectations.slow_motion: Smooth time scale transition. Motion blur present.
